claims.statement: Creation/edit guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES repository-bound milestone grouping. New Milestone or exact existing Edit changes title/description/other metadata with explicit Create/Save; Markdown rendering is presentation, not executable instructions or enforced acceptance.

Deletion guide says issues and PRs are not affected by deleting milestone. This does not substantiate restoration of milestone metadata, preserved associations, reversible deletion or independent acceptance; no deletion performed.

Guide does not specify required permissions, recovery, atomicity or confirmation safeguards beyond Delete link. A deployable mutation binding requires explicit authority/preconditions/diff/readback/recovery review rather than inferred approval.

Filtering guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and milestone:"My Milestone" selector. It selects associated items by name within actual repository/search context, not complete work inventory or verified completion.

Clear-current-search control removes query/filters/sorts; state reset is not deletion of items or milestone associations. CLI list links are references and not evidence all pages or inaccessible items were retrieved.

Repository Milestones navigation lists available milestones and selected page displays associated issues/PRs. Displayed association coverage remains distinct from corpus review, estate scope and independently accepted results.
